rationale: Price has already traded down to $34.78, within $0.18 of the $34.60 invalidation level, and the wide bid-ask spread (80.5 bps) means the effective exit price on a stop trigger would likely be worse than the stated level. The position is only seconds old with no favorable candle data, the stock is sitting at 73.7% of range versus the 87.9% at entry — momentum has clearly faded — and the risk/reward is now asymmetric to the downside given proximity to invalidation. Closing proactively at market preserves more capital than waiting for an automatic stop fill through a wide spread.
